requestBody.value:
@concat(
'<soapenv:Envelope xmlns:soapenv="http://schemas.xmlsoap.org/soap/envelope/" xmlns:v2="http://xmlns.oracle.com/oxp/service/v2">',
    '<soapenv:Header/>',
    '<soapenv:Body>',
        '<v2:runReport>',
            '<v2:reportRequest>',
                '<v2:XDOPropertyList>',
                    '<v2:metaDataList></v2:metaDataList>',
                '</v2:XDOPropertyList>',
                '<v2:attributeFormat>csv</v2:attributeFormat>',
                '<v2:parameterNameValues>',
                    '<v2:listOfParamNameValues>',

                        '<v2:item>',
                            '<v2:name>p_offset</v2:name>',
                            '<v2:values>',
                                '<v2:item>',
                                    string(
                                        mul(
                                            item(),
                                            int(pipeline().parameters.fetch)
                                        )
                                    ),
                                '</v2:item>',
                            '</v2:values>',
                        '</v2:item>',

                        '<v2:item>',
                            '<v2:name>p_fetch</v2:name>',
                            '<v2:values>',
                                '<v2:item>',
                                    string(
                                        min(
                                            int(pipeline().parameters.fetch),
                                            sub(
                                                variables('source_row_count'),
                                                mul(
                                                    item(),
                                                    int(pipeline().parameters.fetch)
                                                )
                                            )
                                        )
                                    ),
                                '</v2:item>',
                            '</v2:values>',
                        '</v2:item>',

                    '</v2:listOfParamNameValues>',
                '</v2:parameterNameValues>',

                '<v2:reportAbsolutePath>',
                    concat(
                        pipeline().parameters.report_path,
                        toUpper(pipeline().parameters.table_name),
                        '_FL.xdo'
                    ),
                '</v2:reportAbsolutePath>',

                '<v2:sizeOfDataChunkDownload>-1</v2:sizeOfDataChunkDownload>',

            '</v2:reportRequest>',
            '<v2:userID>', pipeline().parameters.user_name, '</v2:userID>',
            '<v2:password>', pipeline().parameters.token, '</v2:password>',
        '</v2:runReport>',
    '</soapenv:Body>',
'</soapenv:Envelope>'
)

sql_statement.value:
@concat(
	'select rows_count from transformation_',
	pipeline().globalParameters.environment,
	'.brz_fusion_bip.vw_bip_check_sum where table_name = ''',
	toUpper(pipeline().parameters.table_name),
	''''
)
